what: While scrolling down a long section, a text panel pinned to the screen swaps the blocks one by one — each block takes one step of section height (160vh, 240vh on touch devices) plus one empty step before it. From 12% of the step, each word comes in .04 step later than the last (with many words, the share of dividing .4), and over .032 step it resolves from 5px blur and a ±7px offset from its place, and the flicker word ([data-fx-part=flicker]) lights up to .28, drops to .05, then fills up again. At 78~88% of the cell it scatters to blur 9px and drops out, each line .014 later. Tied to scroll, so rewinding runs it backward

options.block-vh · block-vh-touch: Height of one block (vh), default 160 · touch devices 240
options.from · step · span · ramp: Start of condensing (per cell share) · word gap · max spread per block · length of one word condensing, defaults .12 · .04 · .4 · .032
options.exit-from · exit-to · lag: Fade-out range and per-line delay, default .78 · .88 · .014
options.jitter · blur · blur-out: Offset before settling (px) · blur (px) · blur when leaving (px), default 7 · 5 · 9 — blur only on hover-capable devices
options.height: If keep, the part does not set the section height
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Text panel pinned to the screen (the element itself if none)
options.[data-fx-part=block]:
Block — inside

One per line. Position with left, right, top in style
options.[data-fx-part=flicker]: Word that flickers in (italic alternate font --kf-font-swash)
